author: Master Sgt. Richard Ebensberger
notes: USAF F-35A Lightning II of the 356th Fighter Squadron, Eielson AFB, Alaska (tail 'AK', serial ending 5450), flying alongside a KC-46A over the Pacific on 11 Feb 2022 (USAF photo 220211-F-LP948-9002, original at https://www.af.mil/News/Photos/igphoto/2002941702/; Commons tag PD USAF). Clean left side view, NOSE RIGHT like the cf18 sticker (good for the P2S08->P2S09 'dashed outline' match cut), whole aircraft incl. both tailplanes, canopy and pilot; sky with soft white cloud. Original 7952x4472 (kept as assets-src/tmp-air/orig/f35_220211.jpg) cropped to box 880,1330,6960,3010 and downscaled to 3200x884 (PIL Lanczos, JPEG q95) = photos/f35.jpg. The photo is contrasty and dark on the underside (USAF edit), the grade softens it. Canva remove-background + layer design exported as transparent lossless PNG 3200x884 (pro); final = Canva alpha + photo RGB (scripts/alpha_cutout.py: 1 component, no specks, no holes), subject bbox 3005x679. Sticker 1370x370. Checked at 640 px wide over the grid at 1x and 2x: complete, markings (AK, 5450, roundel) identical to the photo. RCAF ALTERNATIVE NOT FOUND: Commons has no PD/CC BY photo of an RCAF F-35A/CF-35A (first two delivered at Luke AFB on 22 Oct 2026); the Luke AFB/AETC photo pages of that arrival (taxiing on the ground) refuse automated access (HTTP 403) and DVIDS search needs a browser. Second choice kept in reserve: the F-35A that took part in the 24 July 2024 intercept itself (DVIDS 8549617, VIRIN 240724-F-D0430-1004, PD, 3/4 view nose LEFT, assets-src/tmp-air/orig/dv_8549617.jpg).
